ops.write_sop.notes: Okay so first I text the customer when I'm like ten minutes out. Then I walk through the house and take before photos of the kitchen and bathrooms. I always start with the bathrooms because the cleaner needs to sit, um, so spray everything first. After that kitchen counters, stovetop and the sink until it shines. Then dust high to low in every room, fans and shelves first. Floors last, vacuum then mop toward the door. Finally I do a walk through with the checklist and send two after photos to the customer.
